# Kebena Buna

> A living museum of Ethiopian coffee from Jimma: the farms, the process from red cherry to green coffee, the lots on display this season, and the history of coffee in the Gibe region.

The site is published in English, Amharic, Afaan Oromoo, Arabic, Italian and French. Other languages live under a path prefix, for example `/am/` or `/fr/`.

## Pages

- [Museum home](https://kebena-buna.vercel.app/): the entrance, floor plan, the pour from cherry to cup, the farms, the collection, origins, people, archive and visit
- [History](https://kebena-buna.vercel.app/history): the history and origin of coffee, and the Jimma tradition
- [Kingdoms](https://kebena-buna.vercel.app/kingdoms): five kingdoms between the Gibe and the Gojeb
